column1: # navfeeder-esp partition table for the custom GNSS color observer (ESP32-S3).
# The board carries an ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U-N16R8: 16 MB flash
# retired Waveshare C6's. `partitions.csv` describes that unsupported 4 MB layout;
# this file is the default for the supported ESP32-S3 observer.
# Four differences from the 4 MB table
# otherwise sit idle:
#  1. All three application slots are 4 MiB. On-demand HTTPS OTA uses the
#     inactive ota_0/ota_1 slot. The factory app
#     remains the recovery image. Install the OTA-capable app and rollback
#     bootloader together over USB for the initial baseline (README.md).
#  2. The `spool` reservation is 3.25 MiB. docs/PLAN.md
#     §P-spool names flash wear on a 1.5 MiB partition as the binding constraint
#     on the deferred spill tier; spreading the same erase load over about 2.17x the
#     sectors is a direct relaxation of it. This is still a RESERVATION: no
#     component mounts or writes this partition on either board
#     durability envelope in README.md applies unchanged to the S3. Sizing the
#     partition does not create reboot durability.
#  3. The final 512 KiB is a separate NVS FIFO diagnostic journal.
#     Its offset is preserved. Install this table over USB
#     once; app-only OTA cannot add a partition to an older device layout.
#  4. Layout 3 reserves 64 KiB before the partition table at 0x10000 for the
#     Secure Boot v2 bootloader. Configuration
#     old layouts require attended USB commissioning and reprovisioning.
#     Update trust/state gets 128 KiB and encrypted NVS keys get 4 KiB.
#     The spool reservation starts at 0xc40000.
# Offsets left blank are computed by the partition tool. App partitions must
# start on a 64 KiB boundary
